generations.name: Classic
generations.description: The iconic first-generation Subaru Impreza WRX & STI. Developed for the World Rally Championship (WRC), renowned for its lightweight chassis and signature Boxer engine rumble.

wrx.brakes: 2-pot floating front / 1-pot rear (4-pot Subaru on late models)
knownIssues: 5-speed manual transmission vulnerable under high torque (5-speed glass transmission)
Rear wheel arch and shock tower rust
Sensitive Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensors
Head gasket failure on early EJ engines
Cold piston slap and high oil consumption on high-mileage blocks

sti.intercooler: Large Aluminum TMIC with Water Spray
sti.driveType: AWD with Viscous / Helical Rear LSD
knownIssues: High heat concentration on cylinder #4 (Cylinder 4 cooling mod strongly recommended)
Stock 10mm oil pump flow limitation at high RPMs
Rear fender arch rust
Aging knock sensor failure causing engine hesitation

specialEditions.name: Subaru Impreza 22B STi
specialEditions.description: The Holy Grail of Subaru history, built to celebrate Subaru's 40th anniversary and third consecutive WRC title. Features a hand-crafted WRC widebody, Bilstein suspension, and twin-plate clutch.
keyFeatures: Sonic Blue Mica (74F) paint & 17" Gold BBS Wheels
Red Brembo brake calipers with STI branding
knownIssues: Extremely rare and expensive 22B-specific body panels and trim parts
Vintage DCCD center diff requires regular inspection

specialEditions.name: WRX STi Type RA Spec R
specialEditions.description: Ultra-lightweight track spec built for rally homologation (RA = Race Altered). Stripped of sound deadening, thinner glass, no ABS, manually operated roof vent, and ultra-short gearing with DCCD.
knownIssues: High highway RPMs due to ultra-short final drive ratio

generations.name: Bugeye
generations.description: The first 'New Age' Impreza generation featuring iconic round headlights. Introduced a major leap forward in chassis torsional rigidity and occupant safety.

knownIssues: Thin oil causes accelerated rod bearing wear
Clogged catalytic converter in factory uppipe disintegrating into turbo
2nd and 3rd gear synchronizer wear under aggressive shifting
Radiator top plastic end-tank cracking

sti.intercooler: STI TMIC with Water Spray Nozzles
sti.driveType: AWD with DCCD (JDM) or Suretrac Front/Rear LSD
knownIssues: Rear inverted strut clunking noise
Rod bearing failure if operated with low engine oil level
AVCS banjo bolt mesh filter clogging causing camshaft oil starvation

specialEditions.name: Subaru Impreza S202 STi
specialEditions.description: Extreme performance variant developed by STI. Features an adjustable carbon-fiber rear wing, titanium exhaust system, and a raised 8,000 RPM rev limit.
knownIssues: Aggressive ECU tune requires high-octane fuel (100+ RON)

generations.name: Blobeye
generations.description: Restyled by Peter Stevens, the Blobeye remains one of the most beloved generations. Marked the introduction of the 2.5L EJ257 engine for North America and STI's switch to 5x114.3 PCD in 2005.

knownIssues: AVCS banjo bolt filters clog, starving the turbocharger of oil
Torn rubber turbo inlet hose under intake manifold
Raw fuel smell on cold winter startups (loose fuel rail hoses under intake manifold)

sti.intercooler: STI TMIC with Auto/Manual Water Spray
sti.driveType: AWD with DCCD + Helical Front LSD + R180 Rear LSD
knownIssues: Piston ringland failure on EJ257 2.5L engines
Stock EJ257 oil pickup tube cracking leading to engine oil starvation
Rear inverted strut clunking

specialEditions.name: WRX STi Spec C
specialEditions.description: Pure competition-focused model. Features a trunk-mounted 12-liter intercooler spray tank, thinner glass, aluminum roof panel, and complete lack of sound insulation.
knownIssues: Zero creature comforts (no radio, no sound deadening from factory)

generations.name: Hawkeye
generations.description: Front grille styling inspired by Subaru's aviation heritage ('Spread Wings Grille') designed by Andreas Zapatinas. The generation where the 2.5L EJ255/EJ257 engine became the global standard.

wrx.brakes: Subaru 4-pot red front with white lettering / 2-pot rear
knownIssues: Piston ringland failure on EJ255 due to lean fuel maps and knock
Oil pickup tube fracturing
Secondary air pump stuck valve failure

sti.transmission: 6-Speed Manual with Steering Angle Sensor DCCD Auto
sti.driveType: AWD with Driver Control Center Differential (DCCD Auto/Manual)
knownIssues: Head gasket leakage under high boost on EJ257
Cylinder #4 overheating on track days without cooling mod
VF43 turbo wastegate housing crack

specialEditions.name: Subaru Impreza S204 STi
specialEditions.description: Luxury performance masterpiece. Features Recaro carbon-leather bucket seats and Yamaha Performance Dampers mounted between chassis crossmembers.
knownIssues: Recaro Carbon seats require delicate upholstery care
Replacement Yamaha chassis dampers are very expensive

specialEditions.name: WRX STi RB320
specialEditions.description: Tribute special edition dedicated to WRC champion Richard Burns. Finished in Obsidian Black with Prodrive lowering suspension, Eibach springs, and Bilstein dampers.
keyFeatures: RB320 gear knob and embroidered floor mats
knownIssues: Identical ringland failure risk as stock EJ257 if operated without correct Prodrive ECU map

generations.name: Stinkeye Hatchback
generations.description: The first generation offered in a 5-door Hatchback body style with wide rally-inspired fender arches. Marked the transition to rear Double Wishbone suspension.

wrx.engineCode: EJ255 with Dual AVCS (265 HP from 2009+)
knownIssues: Firewall clutch pedal bracket spot weld failure causing pedal squeak and shifting difficulty
Plastic intercooler end-tank crimp seal boost leaks
Cylinder #4 piston ringland failure

sti.driveType: AWD with SI-Drive & Multi-Mode DCCD (Auto+, Auto-, Manual)
knownIssues: Cast factory piston ringland failure on EJ257
Cracked factory oil pickup tube causing oil pressure drop and spun rod bearings
Clutch pedal bracket firewall spot weld failure

specialEditions.name: Subaru Impreza R205 STi
specialEditions.description: Developed by STI using data gathered from the Nürburgring 24 Hours race. Equipped with a custom ball-bearing turbo, low-backpressure exhaust, and Bridgestone RE070 tires.
keyFeatures: STI tuned coil springs and spec Damper Kit
knownIssues: Replacement 6-piston brake rotors and pads are specialized and expensive

generations.name: Stinkeye Sedan
generations.chassisCodes: GVB (STI Sedan Widebody), GVF (WRX Sedan Widebody from 2011)
generations.description: The return of the 4-door Sedan with the massive iconic STI rear wing. From 2011 onwards, the WRX Sedan also received the widebody fenders from the STI.

knownIssues: Firewall pedal bracket spot weld failure
Cylinder #4 ringland failure
Engine knock / LSPI under heavy load at low RPM

sti.driveType: AWD with DCCD and SI-Drive (Intelligent, Sport, Sport Sharp)
knownIssues: Accelerated front lower control arm bushing wear
High engine oil consumption (check dipstick every 500-1000 km)
Head gasket leakage on EJ257

specialEditions.name: Subaru Impreza S206
specialEditions.description: Limited edition created to commemorate Subaru's class victory at the Nürburgring 24h. Pistons, connecting rods, and crankshaft were hand-balanced to near-zero tolerances.
keyFeatures: Carbon-fiber roof & carbon rear spoiler (NBR Package)
Bilstein shocks & STI tuned coil springs
Recaro bucket seats in two-tone leather & Alcantara
knownIssues: High collector value with unique replacement body parts

generations.name: VA Generation
generations.description: The generation where the 'WRX' nameplate officially separated from the Impreza line. The WRX received the direct-injected FA20 DIT engine, while the STI retained the proven EJ257 with chassis and steering refinements.

wrx.driveType: Symmetrical AWD (Viscous Coupling on Manual / VTD on CVT)
knownIssues: Intake valve carbon buildup due to direct injection (walnut blasting recommended every 50,000 km)
LSPI (Low Speed Pre-Ignition) under heavy load at low RPM in high gears
Heavy clutch pedal feel and squeaking clutch throw-out bearing

sti.engineCode: EJ257 Final Edition with revised pistons and ECU mapping
sti.driveType: AWD with fully electronic DCCD (from 2018 facelift without mechanical LSD center)
sti.brakes: Brembo Neon Green / Silver 6-piston front (340mm) / 2-piston rear (from 2018 Facelift)
knownIssues: Piston ringland failure on lower octane fuels
Clutch pedal bracket and rear main oil seal leaks
High fuel consumption compared to modern competitors

specialEditions.name: Subaru STI S209
specialEditions.description: The first STI 'S-line' edition sold officially outside Japan. Features a larger HKS turbocharger, forged pistons, forged connecting rods, and custom widebody fenders.
keyFeatures: Larger HKS turbocharger producing 1.3 bar (18.9 PSI) boost
Factory forged pistons and connecting rods
Widebody fender flares (+2.2 inches) with 19x9.0J BBS Wheels
Steering-wheel controlled intercooler water spray system
knownIssues: Extremely high collector price; unique body parts unavailable via normal dealer stock

specialEditions.name: WRX STI Type RA
specialEditions.description: Anniversary model built for track performance (Record Attempt). Features a carbon-fiber roof, adjustable carbon rear wing, and a revised 3rd gear ratio.
keyFeatures: Carbon-fiber roof panel and rear wing
Reinforced pistons and free-flowing STI performance exhaust
Revised 3rd gear ratio for faster acceleration
knownIssues: Sensitive engine oil temp management during prolonged track use

generations.name: VB Generation
generations.description: Built on the Subaru Global Platform (SGP), offering a 28% increase in torsional rigidity. Powered by the new 2.4-liter FA24F Turbo engine, delivering great throttle response and tuning potential.

wrx.stockBoost: 0.8 bar (12 PSI stock - massive ECU tuning overhead)
wrx.transmission: 6-Speed Manual or Subaru Performance Transmission (SPT / CVT)
wrx.driveType: Symmetrical AWD (VTD on SPT / Viscous on Manual)
wrx.brakes: 2-pot floating front (316mm) / 1-pot rear (290mm) [Brembo on TR / tS trim]
knownIssues: Excess factory oil pan RTV sealant breaking loose into oil pickup strainer
Polarizing unpainted plastic wheel arch cladding
Intake valve carbon accumulation from direct injection

specialEditions.name: WRX TR / WRX tS
specialEditions.description: Track-focused performance package. Features 6-piston Brembo brakes, ergonomic Recaro bucket seats, re-tuned steering rack, and stiffer springs.
keyFeatures: Red 6-piston Brembo front / 2-piston rear brake system
Stiffened performance suspension with moonroof delete for weight reduction
19-inch satin grey alloy wheels with Bridgestone Potenza S007 tires
knownIssues: Firm ride quality on poorly paved roads

torqueSpecs.notes: Tighten in star pattern. Re-torque after 50 km (30 miles).
Always replace the copper/crush washer at every oil change!
Apply dielectric grease to boot. Do not over-torque!

torqueSpecs.torqueNm: Step 1: 29 Nm, Step 2: 69 Nm, Back off 180°, Step 3: 47 Nm, Final Angle: 80-90°
torqueSpecs.notes: Strictly follow the OEM Subaru tightening sequence from service manual.
Apply blue Medium Threadlocker (Loctite 242) to threads.
Tighten evenly in a star pattern to prevent diaphragm spring warping.

torqueSpecs.component: Front Brake Caliper Mounting Bolts (Brembo / Standard)
torqueSpecs.notes: Be careful with aluminum Brembo caliper threads - always use a torque wrench!
Torque with vehicle resting on wheels at ride height.

fluidCapacities.system: EJ Engine Oil (EJ205, EJ207, EJ255, EJ257)
fluidCapacities.recommendedViscosity: 5W-40 or 10W-40 Full Synthetic (Motul 300V, Shell Helix Ultra, Liqui Moly)
fluidCapacities.notes: Check oil dipstick level at every fuel refill!
Use high quality oil to prevent intake valve carbon deposits.
Transmission shares fluid with the front differential.
Includes internal oil pump flow circuit on equipped models.
Clean magnetic drain plug at every fluid flush.

fluidCapacities.recommendedViscosity: Subaru Super Coolant (Blue Pre-mixed) or Silicate-Free Ethylene Glycol
fluidCapacities.notes: Add one bottle of OEM Subaru Coolant Conditioner when refilling.

fluidCapacities.recommendedViscosity: DOT 4 or DOT 5.1 High Performance (Motul RBF600)
fluidCapacities.notes: Bleed calipers in order: Right Rear, Left Front, Left Rear, Right Front.
